# Vendored mojoAL

This directory contains a vendored copy of [mojoAL](https://github.com/icculus/mojoAL),
a single-file OpenAL 1.1 implementation built on SDL2.

- Branch: `sdl2`
- Commit: `cac5f3ff2af9fba2df111e91c9dd3dec0e630272`
- Files: `mojoal.c`, `AL/al.h`, `AL/alc.h`, `LICENSE.txt`, `README.md`

mojoAL is licensed under the zlib license; see `LICENSE.txt`.

To update, replace the files above with the contents of the desired upstream
commit and update the commit hash in this file.
